title: Morocco Returns to GMT Permanently After Summer — Government Makes It Official
body:
Morocco will permanently revert to GMT+0 after the current summer period, government spokesman Mustapha Baitas confirmed. The decision ends years of debate over Morocco's controversial GMT+1 year-round policy adopted in 2018.

Impact

After the transition, Morocco returns to the same timezone as the UK in winter — one hour behind France and Spain. Marrakech residents will see earlier winter sunrises, previously delayed to as late as 8:30 AM in December. European business meeting schedules will need adjustment.

Source: Kech24, Moroccan government press conference.
